run.command: strata bench run --profile unsloth-ud-iq4_xs-v31 --track custom --track-notes CachyOS Linux, kernel 7.3.4-1-cachyos. Changed from setup's config: --resident-budget-gib 52 (setup wrote 40), --aux-cpus auto (added), env STRATA_IQ4_W4A8=1, STRATA_ENGINE_NICE=0, STRATA_ROUTE_PRIOR=0 (the default, set explicitly). System: 64 GB DDR5-6000 (2 x 32 GB, as configured), RTX 3090 power limit 280 W (lowered from the 350 W default), gpu-unlock 2.0.0 loaded (third-party kernel module that lifts the GeForce half-rate cap on FP16/BF16/TF32 tensor maths), /sys/kernel/mm/lru_gen/min_ttl_ms=0 (CachyOS default 100; 0 stops early OOM kills of the pinned engine), swap off, systemd-oomd off, vm.swappiness=150, a minimal self-made desktop (about 50 MB of RAM), desktop on the Radeon iGPU (RTX 3090 drives no display). --background minimal self-made desktop session (about 50 MB of RAM)

background_workloads: minimal self-made desktop session (about 50 MB of RAM)
